verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships its own developer API, a 67-path OpenAPI 3.0 spec under /v1/ for reading, writing, updating and chatting with workspaces, with Swagger docs served on each instance. Nothing documents that the API covers everything the UI can do, so parity is unproven. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity claim or coverage mapping, evidence that admin/permission, agent-flow and white-label settings are API-reachable, independent hands-on confirmation of parity, a vendor-hosted API (the API exists only on self-hosted/desktop instances).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: API endpoints that enable programmatic reading, writing, and updating of your AnythingLLM instance.
AnythingLLM supports a full developer API that you can use to manage, update, embed, and even chat with your workspaces
